name: Boliden AB (publ)
research_rationale: Q3 2026 interim and 2025 ESEF back solid cyclical earnings and governance, but capex-heavy FCF, Nexa-linked leverage and metal-price dependence only partly confirm the screen buy case.

weekly_updates.summary:
Q3 2026 interim (29 Oct): stable mines/smelters; operating profit ex-PIR SEK 4,894m; free cash flow SEK 1,121m; nine-month FCF still thin at SEK 680m.  
Nexa stake agreement and net debt SEK 18,335m extend leverage; Yahoo TTM FCF ~SEK 3.75bn sits below prior annual levels amid heavy capex.  
News is mixed on fair value (split targets, DCF “undervalued” pieces with FCF caveats); EU local-refining theme is incremental, not filed.
